messages:
Aria (People Ops): @here quick reminder and small policy tweak for hybrid travel & PTO ahead of the summer offsite season. Two items: 1) Code-of-conduct reminder for work travel/offsites: personal conduct expectations, expense policy compliance, and harassment reporting steps. 2) Team-offsite blackout + PTO coordination: teams can request a 2-week blackout window for critical launches but must publish it 6 weeks ahead. Also a new small convenience: developers on travel can convert a single partial-day of travel-related downtime (<4h) to a "Wellness Buffer" without touching PTO once per quarter. Details: https://redwood.company/hr/travel-conduct-offsites :memo:
Dex (Eng): For the Wellness Buffer, does it stack with oncall recovery? Example: late-night flight then pager.
Aria (People Ops): Good Q. The Wellness Buffer is separate from oncall recovery. You can use both but total non-working credited time in a single 7-day window is capped at 16 hours. Managers will see both entries.
Mina (Sales): Code-of-conduct training for offsites 1? mandatory?
Carlos (Legal): Short answer: yes for company-sponsored offsites. A 10-minute micro-course will be assigned at registration and must be completed before travel authorization. Non-completion will block reimbursement.
Dex (Eng): Blackout windows 1 what if my team needs an exception for a critical bugfix?
Aria (People Ops): Managers can request an exception; People Ops will work with Product/Eng leadership. Exceptions should be rare and justified.
Payroll Bot: FYI: Wellness Buffer usage will be visible on payslips as "Wellness Buffer" and does not reduce PTO. Expense reimbursements follow the standard policy.
Mina (Sales): What about guests/spouses on offsites? Travel expenses?
Aria (People Ops): Spouses/guests are personal expense unless otherwise approved for specific supplier events. Please submit guest approvals at least 10 business days before travel.
Carlos (Legal): Reminder: harassment reporting is confidential. If you need immediate support while traveling, contact Security + People Ops via the incident form: https://redwood.company/safety/report.
Dex (Eng): Thanks, good to have clarity. Small ask: can we add a line in the offsite registration form about blackout conflicts?
Aria (People Ops): Yep, will add that today. We'll monitor adoption this quarter and share a short FAQ. DM if edge cases. :sun_with_face:
